title: Finiteness and Construction of Internal Hom for Vertex Operator Algebras
summary: Let $V$ be a vertex operator algebra, and let $W^1$ and $W^2$ be restricted $V$-modules. We construct a generalized $V$-module $\mathcal{H}(W^1, W^2)$ characterized by canonical universal properties. We show that, under suitable hypotheses, $ \mathcal{H}(W^1, W^2)$ realizes the internal Hom object in the tensor category of restricted $V$-modules. Although our construction differs from Li's, we show that it agrees with the natural logarithmic generalization of Li's module $Δ(W^1, W^2)$.
